candidate.basis: Strict subset of the existing registered allocation range; no new IP addresses or subnet introduced.

requiredBeforeApproval: Exact current listPods ipranges including CIDR/VLAN/forsystemvms, not deprecated unpaired endpoints only
Exact scoped listCapacity type 5 with fresh derived count; zero allocations required for this simple controller
Fresh SystemVM, router, user VM and host address inventories consistent with zero Pod allocations
Trusted Hyper-V DHCP scopes/exclusions/reservations/current leases, static host/VM address and neighbor evidence; silence is not proof of vacancy
No active jobs or other allocation writers; source Zone remains Disabled
nativeProtection: checkIpRangeContainsTakenAddresses retains all existing taken addresses or rejects the update; never bypass this gate
submissionProtocol: Persist exact current/new endpoints and SUBMITTING before one native async submission
Record returned async job ID and query only that job
On uncertain result re-list exact Pod ipranges; never re-submit an ambiguous earlier request
Verify start/end, original gateway/CIDR/VLAN/forsystemvms preserved, then fresh native capacity totals
Keep Zone Disabled; do not enable SystemVM allocation in this step
unresolved: DHCP and private-IP allocated-count evidence not yet collected
